intro: Four pieces of tempe goreng are about 230 kcal (estimate). Tempe itself has protein and fat, and the frying oil adds roughly one third of the calories.

breakdown.part: Marinade of salt, turmeric and onion

diet: Yes, you can. Tempe is one of the best and cheapest plant-based protein sources. Four pieces give you about 13 g of protein. The only thing to watch is the oil, so pick plain fried tempe over the flour-coated or sugary versions.
tips: Cook it in an air fryer or a pan with just a little oil.
Drain on kitchen paper after frying to remove excess oil.
At the warung, choose plain fried tempe over sambal tempe, which is sweeter and oilier.

swap.name: Air fryer tempe (4 pieces)
swap.why: Still crispy, but uses much less oil. Protein stays the same.

faq.q: Tempe or tofu, which has more protein?
faq.a: For the same weight, tempe usually has more protein and fibre than soft tofu.

faq.q: Are the black spots on tempe a sign it's gone bad?
faq.a: A few black or grey spots are usually normal, from the tempe mould. If it smells strongly of ammonia or feels slimy, throw it away.
Yes. Tempe is made from soybeans and is a main protein source for many vegetarians.
